steamed_bun.name: Steamed Bun
steamed_bun.description: Still warm from Ama's steamer. A street fighter's best friend.

ginger_tea.name: Ginger Tea
ginger_tea.description: Fiery enough to wake the dead. Restores body and breath.

rice_box.name: Rice Box
rice_box.description: Rice, basil pork and a fried egg in a paper box. A night shift's whole meal.

herbal_tonic.name: Herbal Tonic
herbal_tonic.description: A bitter green tonic from an old pharmacy jar. Bones knit, breath comes back.

taped_knuckles.name: Taped Knuckles
taped_knuckles.description: Cloth tape wound tight over the knuckles. Simple and honest.

rebar_pipe.name: Rebar Pipe
rebar_pipe.description: Pried from a collapsed scaffold. Heavy, but it makes a point.

foreman_wrench.name: Foreman's Wrench
foreman_wrench.description: Taken from the Sludge Foreman. It still smells of the Murk.

dock_beanie.name: Dock Beanie
dock_beanie.description: Knitted wool, salt-stained. Keeps your head warm on night shifts.

hard_hat.name: Hard Hat
hard_hat.description: Depot issue. Rated for falling bolts and flying fists.

padded_vest.name: Padded Vest
padded_vest.description: Quilted canvas over a cotton shirt. Takes the edge off a punch.

work_jacket.name: Work Jacket
work_jacket.description: Thick leather with brass studs. Looks the part, too.

fingerless_gloves.name: Fingerless Gloves
fingerless_gloves.description: A firmer grip and a little more bite on every jab.

iron_wraps.name: Iron Wraps
iron_wraps.description: Chain links sewn into leather wraps. The Warden's favourite.

canvas_sneakers.name: Canvas Sneakers
canvas_sneakers.description: Light on your feet, quick out of trouble.

steel_toe_boots.name: Steel-toe Boots
steel_toe_boots.description: Heavy boots for heavy work. You will not be knocked off balance easily.

lucky_coin.name: Lucky Coin
lucky_coin.description: An old harbour coin with a hole punched through. Tar Rats hoard them.

brass_whistle.name: Brass Whistle
brass_whistle.description: The Chief's own whistle, given for clearing Saltmarket. Calls the crew.

riveted_jacket.name: Riveted Jacket
riveted_jacket.description: Rail-yard leather with steel rivets. Turns a knife.

street_runners.name: Street Runners
street_runners.description: Night-market sneakers with soles that grip wet tiles.

brass_knuckles.name: Brass Knuckles
brass_knuckles.description: Heavy brass rings. Every punch lands like a hammer.

iron_helm.name: Iron Helm
iron_helm.description: A refinery safety helmet, dented but solid.

jade_charm.name: Jade Charm
jade_charm.description: A carved jade tiger. The Baron never let it out of his sight.

baron_knuckledusters.name: Baron's Knuckledusters
baron_knuckledusters.description: Still hot from the furnace. Taken from the Baron himself.

torn_label.name: Torn Shipping Label
torn_label.description: Ripped off the crate the Saltmarket crew came back for. No waybill, no address: just a red stamp, KRAISORN HEAVY INDUSTRIES.

forged_note.name: Forged Delivery Note
forged_note.description: Found on the Sludge Foreman. Stamped and signed for a warehouse on the canal that burned down years ago. Someone is moving freight on paper that cannot be real.

baron_ledger.name: The Baron's Ledger
baron_ledger.description: The Furnace Baron's accounts. Every week, the same payment from an account at the port, marked only "for the route". He was renting South Street to someone.

scrap_metal.name: Scrap Metal
scrap_metal.description: Bent bolts and offcuts from the street. The Depot workbench turns it into upgrades for whatever you wear.

refined_alloy.name: Refined Alloy
refined_alloy.description: A clean factory ingot, far too good for South Street. Tough fighters carry it; high upgrades need it.

champion_wraps.name: Champion's Wraps
champion_wraps.description: Taped and re-taped through a hundred nights in the alley ring. Whoever wore these never lost on his feet.

dockers_cap.name: Docker's Cap
dockers_cap.description: A padded cap from the port crews, made to take a swinging hook.

port_jacket.name: Port Authority Jacket
port_jacket.description: Heavy canvas with reflective strips. Someone left it on a crate.

deck_boots.name: Deck Boots
deck_boots.description: Rubber soles for wet steel decks.

harbour_hook.name: Harbourmaster's Hook
harbour_hook.description: Chen's cargo hook, worn smooth by forty years of crates.

altered_manifest.name: The Altered Manifest
altered_manifest.description: A cargo manifest with its destination scratched out and rewritten by hand: a factory in the Industrial District, stamped with the same mark as the crate from the first night.

hazmat_hood.name: Hazmat Hood
hazmat_hood.description: Rubberised hood from a plant locker. Smells of chemicals.

plant_vest.name: Plant Security Vest
plant_vest.description: Padded vest with a plate sewn into the back.

insulated_gloves.name: Insulated Gloves
insulated_gloves.description: Rated for live wires. Good for live fights too.

lab_boots.name: Lab Boots
lab_boots.description: Acid-proof soles that do not slip on wet floors.

chiefs_baton.name: Chief's Baton
chiefs_baton.description: Nattapong left it behind when he walked out.

k7_core_plate.name: K-7 Core Plate
k7_core_plate.description: A warm plate from K-7's chest. It hums when you fight.

waste_sample.name: Waste Sample
waste_sample.description: Black sludge from the factory's waste pools, sealed in Dr. Pim's sample jar. The same sludge that fills the canal.

experiment_log.name: Experiment Log
experiment_log.description: A logbook from under the factory. Page after page of readings, and one line underlined twice: "The Core must not stop. Report every failure to the Director only."

watch_cap.name: Night Watch Cap
watch_cap.description: A warehouse watchman's cap with a steel lining sewn in.

kevlar_jacket.name: Kevlar Jacket
kevlar_jacket.description: Sold off the back of a truck. Nobody asks which truck.

fight_gloves.name: Taped Fight Gloves
fight_gloves.description: Thin leather under fresh tape, the way the ring fighters wear them.

runner_sneakers.name: Runner Sneakers
runner_sneakers.description: Light soles for people who carry cash and cannot be caught.

ringmaster_wraps.name: Ringmaster's Wraps
ringmaster_wraps.description: Red wraps the Ringmaster wore for every fight he fixed.

sak_signet.name: Sak's Signet
sak_signet.description: A heavy gold ring with the gang's mark. It opened every door on South Street.

money_trail.name: Money Trail
money_trail.description: Transfer slips from the Counting House. Every month the same sum leaves Kraisorn Heavy Industries for Big Sak's accounts, each slip approved by one name: Director Wiroj.

facility_pass.name: Core Facility Pass
facility_pass.description: Big Sak's keycard and a hand-drawn map to the Core Facility north of the factories. On the back: "Final activation in seven days. Keep the city quiet until then."

facility_helmet.name: Facility Helmet
facility_helmet.description: A trooper's helmet with the unit number scratched off.

trooper_vest.name: Trooper Vest
trooper_vest.description: Ceramic plates in a black carrier. Heavier than it looks.

grip_gloves.name: Lab Grip Gloves
grip_gloves.description: Rubber-palmed gloves for handling heavy samples. And heavy people.

facility_boots.name: Facility Boots
facility_boots.description: Anti-static soles that never slip on a clean floor.

subject_band.name: Subject 12's Band
subject_band.description: His patient band. The name on it was a worker's, before it was a number.

arthit_baton.name: Commander's Baton
arthit_baton.description: Arthit's steel baton. He carried it for thirty years and never used it in the city, until now.

exposure_report.name: Exposure Report
exposure_report.description: The Test Labs' own report: night-shift workers kept near The Core for months, their skin turned green, their strength doubled, their memories going. "Effects reverse if exposure stops." Nobody stopped it.

core_source_data.name: Core Source Data
core_source_data.description: The Core's original design, from the Control Room. It was built to clean the canal, and it did, until they pushed it ten times past its limit and buried every failure. The final activation pushes it further still.

core_guard_helm.name: Core Guard Helm
core_guard_helm.description: A sentinel's visor, pried off and padded for a human head.

reactor_plate.name: Reactor Plate
reactor_plate.description: Lead-lined plating from the reactor walkway. Heavy, and worth it.

insulated_gauntlets.name: Insulated Gauntlets
insulated_gauntlets.description: Made for live machinery. They take a shock and give one back.

walkway_boots.name: Walkway Boots
walkway_boots.description: Grip soles for wet steel gratings and fast exits.

director_signet.name: Director's Signet
director_signet.description: Kraisorn Heavy Industries' seal on a white-gold ring. It signed away a canal.

mothers_fang.name: Mother's Fang
mothers_fang.description: A tooth the size of a fist, set in tar-black tape. The drains remember who took it.

mothers_heart.name: Mother's Heart
mothers_heart.description: A green stone from the heart of the Great Drain. It beats, slowly, when you fight.

colossus_core.name: Colossus Core
colossus_core.description: The Colossus's power cell, still warm. It hums in time with your heart.

piston_gauntlets.name: Piston Gauntlets
piston_gauntlets.description: Hydraulic fists from the Colossus's arms. Every punch lands like a press.

zeros_mantle.name: Zero's Mantle
zeros_mantle.description: The first worker's lab coat, hardened by years in the sludge. It turns blades.

iron_legacy.name: The Iron Legacy
iron_legacy.description: Knuckles forged from the Core Chamber's last door. South Street's story, worn on your fists.
